name: TH18 Anti-3-Star War Base
description: A compartment-heavy war layout built around a central Town Hall with layered wall rings. The outer ring slows ground troops while the inner core keeps high-value defences separated from each other.
strategyNotes: Town Hall sits inside a double wall ring to deny an easy two-star path through the centre.
Resource storages are placed outside the core to pull attackers away from defences.
Splash defences are spread so a single freeze spell cannot cover both air and ground threats.
Wide outer channels reduce the value of Wall Breakers on the first wall layer.
